assemblyNotes: Retained source assembled cluster; only the recorded rigid rotation and translation are applied. Original millimetres and relative positions preserved.

derivedParts.notes: STL is the heat-resistant shield, not a populated PCB. Only a neutral board-space placeholder is added; no components inferred.
Photo-rectified film on native cover; four corners / placement +/-0.5mm. Dark printed background is genuine film, not bare case; screw pixels excluded.

limitations: View displays one module, not all five loose units in the package.
Same module source geometry as DIY kit does not merge the SKU identity, package weight or included accessories.
CAD thickness 4.4 mm differs from documented 4.6 mm.
Runtime board/peripherals are not implemented for this SKU; geometry preview does not establish firmware compatibility.
